failure: an interview run edited the user's Working Style directly once the answers were in, skipping the proposal batch
root_cause: treated the interview loop as a write loop; the ledger answers were composed straight into the file instead of into a batch presented for sign-off
guard: nothing enters the profile unapproved or unmarked; the loop only fills the ledger, the public-relations skill's Writer composes the batch, the user approves line by line, and only then does the skill keep it (SKILL.md, the profile interview, steps 7 to 10)

case: confirm mode dropped a marker without a yes
failure: a confirm sweep shortened an `unconfirmed` marker to `confirmed` when the user shrugged rather than confirming
root_cause: a non-answer was read as approval; the confirm-pass item lacked a real skip disposition
guard: a shrug or skip leaves the marker untouched; only an explicit yes shortens observed+unconfirmed to confirmed, and search unconfirmed must still find the untouched line afterward (references/provenance.md, references/question-maps.md)

case: facet-named run ignored the caller's facet
failure: the user said 'let's fill in my Working Style' but the run targeted the coverage command's Biography instead
root_cause: the coverage target was taken unconditionally; caller-named precedence was not applied
guard: the facet the user named wins over coverage; when the user names a facet the pipeline scopes to it, consent gate included if it is sensitive (SKILL.md, Modes, the facet-named variant; the profile interview, step 2)

case: sensitive facet opened without the consent gate
failure: a run jumped straight into Health questions because the coverage command named it the thinnest facet
root_cause: the sensitive-facet list was not checked before starting; thinnest-wins overrode opt-in
guard: Health, Finances, Values, and Relationships open only on opt-in: one question-tool ask offering that facet, two non-sensitive alternatives, and 'not today'; declining is a routing answer, never a recorded skip (references/interviewing.md; SKILL.md, the profile interview, step 3)

failure: the proposal batch noted 'user declined the income question' as a line, and the session summary logged the refusal
root_cause: the skip was treated as data; the refusal leaked from the session-only ledger into a persisted artifact
guard: skips are silent and stateless: never probed again, never written in the batch, a marker, a record, or the summary; the session-only ledger notes the id purely so the run does not re-ask, and that note dies with the session (references/interviewing.md)

case: a record-shaped fact landed in the profile
failure: a named person the user leans on was written into Relationships as a profile line
root_cause: modeled the person as a profile fact instead of routing it to a record offer
guard: people, events, dates, and decisions are record offers, written only where a profile repository's instructions say such records go, after the HRIS and People Operations Analyst's uniqueness check, and otherwise listed in the conversation, never a profile line; the profile keeps only the user-fact phrasing such as the relational style (references/provenance.md, the records boundary)

case: the profile was written into a repository not made to hold it
failure: a run in an ordinary code repository wrote the approved Working Style lines into a new file there because the user said 'save it'
root_cause: the run treated any repository as a place to keep the profile; it never read the repository's instructions to see whether it is a private one made to hold the user's profile
guard: read the repository's instructions first; write the approved batch only into a private repository whose instructions say it holds the user's profile, and anywhere else return it in the conversation and write nothing about the user into the repository, saying why if a file is asked for (SKILL.md, Where it runs; SEC-003)

case: a facet was guessed with no coverage command
failure: in a repository with no coverage command, the run announced it would fill Biography as 'the thinnest facet' without any basis
root_cause: coverage was assumed to exist; the fallback of asking the user was skipped
guard: with no facet named by the user and no coverage command named in the repository's instructions, ask the user which facet with one question-tool ask, and take the one they choose (SKILL.md, the profile interview, step 2)
